readout_other: c-fos, Iba-1, CD68 and CD206 immunofluorescence; cGAS-STING western blots; left stellate ganglion neural activity; echocardiography; programmed electrophysiologic stimulation (ERP, VA inducibility)
direction_notes: LTUS of the PVN reduced post-MI c-fos in PVN, left stellate ganglion neural activity and microglial/cGAS-STING neuroinflammation, and improved cardiac remodeling and arrhythmia inducibility.
safety_notes: H&E of lung, liver, spleen, kidney and brain, TUNEL in the PVN and thermal imaging showed no overt pathology, apoptosis or temperature change.

exposures.label: LTUS to the PVN, daily for 4 weeks

device.manufacturer: Haobro Medical Device Co, Ltd, Soochow, China

timing.protocol_description: The cranial surface covering the PVN region was irradiated for 15 minutes daily for 4 consecutive weeks after MI modelling. Acoustic parameters are in Supplemental Table S1, not in the main text.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Thirty-six SD rats were randomized to 3 groups: the sham group (n 5 12, pseudo-MI modeling), the CMI group (n 5 12, MI modeling), and the LTUS group (n 5 12, MI modeling and LTUS intervention).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The ultrasound instrument (HB810B; Haobro Medical Device Co, Ltd, Soochow, China) was employed to irradiate the cranial surface covering the PVN region for a duration of 15 minutes daily in the LTUS groups.

flags.reason: 15 min per day is recorded as 900 s; this is the daily irradiation time, and whether it is one continuous train is not stated.
36 rats in three groups; only the LTUS group (n=12) received ultrasound. The text prints n = as 'n 5'.
All acoustic parameters are in Supplemental Table S1, not in the main text.
Isoflurane stated for surgery; anaesthesia during stimulation is not stated.
The sham group is a pseudo-MI surgical sham and the CMI group is MI without ultrasound; the paper does not describe any sham ultrasound.
